article.headline: Scores from last Night: Magnolia ends road drought with 36–34 win
article.html:
Magnolia finally left the road with a win. The Wildcats from Terry edged Gulf Coast Elite Homeschool 36–34 in Pascagoula on Saturday, October 24, 2026, ending an 11-game road losing streak, according to MaxPreps. The boys varsity football result gives this edition of Scores from last Night its focus: a close conference victory with a meaningful change in Magnolia’s recent road record.

Boys football: Magnolia breaks through away from home

The MaxPreps recap places Magnolia at 2–7 after the victory and traces its road drought to the previous season. Gulf Coast Elite Homeschool’s updated record is 1–7, with six consecutive defeats. Saturday’s narrow result ended one losing run while extending the other.

The dated matchup report identifies Magnolia as the visiting winner and Gulf Coast Elite Homeschool as the host. Both programs are Mississippi teams, with the Wildcats based in Terry and the Elite in Pascagoula.

A verified final with limited scoring detail

The posted boxscore supplies the 36–34 final but leaves every quarter’s scoring field blank. It supports the result without establishing when Magnolia took the lead or how either team’s scoring developed. No decisive play or individual performance can be identified from those fields.
